items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. Oh, he's (unintelligible) good friend of Sandy Williams... [INTERVIEWEE] Even before that, that's true.

ctx.x: Yeah. Oh, he's (unintelligible) good friend of Sandy Williams. Well, Sandy, he was getting some teeth, you know, and these things, wished he had a little more money. Well, I lent him around $25.00 or something, which was about all I could -- or maybe 50.00, I'm not sure, but -- and I gave it to him. I said, no, I'm not going to lend it to you. You know, my father always told me that. He said --
